description: Solimena — Colore: Silvery gold & peach Codice: 5490 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Floral Scala: Large Altezza: 140 cm Rapporto: 140 cm × 54.5 cm Toni: Orange The Neapolitan Baroque painter Francesco SOLIMENA was an exceptionally popular artist in his time, amassing great wealth and patronage, especially from the future Pope Benedict XIII and King Louis XIV of France. SOLIMENA painted many frescoes, altarpieces, and mythological subjects that were marked for their theatrical drama. The same could be said of our SOLIMENA, which features richly detailed floral garlands in a vivid and affecting composition.
